name: jfolio
description: jFolio - 개인 금융자산 통합 관리 시스템 (market data collection + portfolio valuation + signals)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "yarn workspace @jfolio/api dev" "yarn workspace @jfolio/web dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @jfolio/shared typecheck && yarn workspace @jfolio/api build && yarn workspace @jfolio/web build
scripts.test: yarn workspace @jfolio/shared test && yarn workspace @jfolio/api test && yarn workspace @jfolio/web test
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @jfolio/shared typecheck && yarn workspace @jfolio/api typecheck && yarn workspace @jfolio/web typecheck
